# x-monitor

> A read-only OpenClaw skill that fetches replies to a tweet via Camofox + Nitter without login, flags questions, and in watch mode reports only new replies.

x-monitor 是一个只读、免登录的 X/推特评论监控工具（OpenClaw 技能），标出评论区提问，watch 模式只返回新增评论。

It is a plain Python CLI that prints JSON. Drafting answers is done by the AI agent that calls it; x-monitor never posts.

## Requirements

- Python 3.7+ (standard library only)
- Camofox (https://github.com/jo-inc/camofox-browser) listening on port 9377
- A working Nitter instance (default: nitter.net)

## Install and run

    git clone https://github.com/ythx-101/x-monitor.git && cd x-monitor
    python3 scripts/monitor.py --url "https://x.com/username/status/123456"
    python3 scripts/monitor.py --url "https://x.com/username/status/123456" --watch

## Options

- --url, -u: tweet URL (required)
- --watch, -w: show only new replies since the last check
- --pretty, -p: pretty-print JSON
- --port: Camofox port (default 9377)
- --nitter: Nitter instance host (default nitter.net)

## Output fields

- Top level: tweet_url, username, tweet_id, checked_at, total_replies, questions, question_count, replies (default mode) or new_replies and new_count (--watch), error (on failure)
- Each reply: author, author_name, text, time_ago, likes, replies, views, media, is_question

## Limitations

- Read-only: no posting or replying
- Depends on Nitter instance availability and on Camofox
- Question detection is a keyword/question-mark heuristic (Chinese and English), not AI classification
- Parses page snapshots, so page structure changes can break it
